actions.action: Move plant to brightest spot (south/west window with direct sun)
Alternatively, set up a cheap LED grow light close to plant for 12-14 hours a day
Check soil and water thoroughly only when completely dry
Ensure pot drains freely, optionally switch to terracotta
Remove dried leaves from soil surface
Cut off top rosette with clean blade leaving a few inches of stem
Let cutting callus 2-4 days, then set on dry gritty cactus mix
Water cutting lightly once it is rooting

reason: Etiolation is the main diagnosis, and moving to more light plus beheading and propagating matches the thread's fix with nothing harmful.
